crossRefs.note: But before all these things, they will lay their hands on you and will persecute you, delivering you up to synagogues…
But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to councils, and in their synagogues they will scourge you.
Therefore behold, I send to you prophets, wise men, and scribes. Some of them you will kill and crucify; and some of…
But watch yourselves, for they will deliver you up to councils. You will be beaten in synagogues. You will stand before…
In the morning, their rulers, elders, and scribes were gathered together in Jerusalem.
When they had brought them, they set them before the council. The high priest questioned them,
But some of those who were of the synagogue called “The Libertines”, and of the Cyrenians, of the Alexandrians, and of…

translations.web: When they bring you before the synagogues, the rulers, and the authorities, don’t be anxious how or what you will answer, or what you will say;
translations.bsb: When you are brought before synagogues, rulers, and authorities, do not worry about how to defend yourselves or what to say.
translations.kjv: And when they bring you unto the synagogues, and unto magistrates, and powers, take ye no thought how or what thing ye shall answer, or what ye shall say:
translations.asv: And when they bring you before the synagogues, and the rulers, and the authorities, be not anxious how or what ye shall answer, or what ye shall say:
